The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's decision at step 9. After WebSurfer hit a DNS error on Ensembl (step 8), the Orchestrator treated that single failure as a dead end and redirected the team to NCBI. Ensembl was the correct source, since the answer is an Ensembl release-101 GFF3 file. Retrying Ensembl, or going directly to ftp.ensembl.org, would likely have found it. Instead, the team followed NCBI and got stuck in a loop of scholarly-article pages.

AGENT: Orchestrator (thought)
STEP: 9
